baseline_constraints: Preserve the existing controller, source of truth, and release gates unless an approved migration says otherwise.
Keep customer facts, approvals, credentials, personal data, and production configuration outside the toolbox repository.
Do not infer system access, business rules, certifications, outcomes, or commercial authority from a job description or template.
Use the smallest real workflow slice that can be independently evaluated.
Separate prototype acceptance, production readiness, user adoption, and commercial activation.
first_deliverable: One verified local workflow artifact based on current approved facts.
